clearanceRequestTemplate: Subject: Exact-model photo permission for milchpumpe-vergleich.de — [EXACT MODEL / REGION / SET]. We publish independent, neutral product comparisons on https://milchpumpe-vergleich.de, a commercial editorial website with Amazon.de affiliate links (tracking ID andreasboeh09-21). Please provide exact-model product-only photo asset IDs/files and confirm in writing that we may self-host and display the identified photographs on these pages, including comparisons with other brands and Amazon-linked monetization, without implying manufacturer endorsement or our own hands-on test. Please state the licensor/photographer, permitted term and territories (worldwide internet visibility), required credit/licence link, resize/crop rights, and whether any other releases are needed. Please confirm organic Pinterest reuploads linking to our editorial articles and text overlays separately; we will not assume paid advertising is covered. Please identify the approved acquisition channel and whether an automated download is permitted. If permission is restricted to your own affiliate programme or destination, please say so. No photograph will be published before this permission and exact model identity are established.
retrievalLimits: Configured SearXNG was unreachable; search fell back to Exa/keyless results. Empty and irrelevant results were not treated as market-wide absence.
web_extract reported insufficient Firecrawl credits. No credits were purchased; live public HTML and ordinary rendered Chrome tabs were used instead.
The initial browser-use helper timed out; existing Chrome DevTools tooling worked in a separate isolated photo-rights browser context.
GlobeNewswire direct HTTP returned 403; the public release rendered normally in Chrome. A guessed GlobeNewswire terms URL also returned 403 and is not treated as legal authority.
The Medela launch portal linked by the release and a modern-path candidate returned 404. Neither was treated as a licence.
Research is limited, not a claim that no possible licence or exact photograph exists. Actual permission or a conclusively identified freely licensed photograph could change the decision.
